# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues. Send an e-mail to
[Marius.Neuwirth@isi.fraunhofer.de](mailto:Marius.Neuwirth@isi.fraunhofer.de) with a description of the problem
and, if possible, steps to reproduce it. You can expect an answer within a few working days.
